data.name: 1K-Nights
data.detailed_description:
1K-Night

Scavenge, fight, recruit allies, and descend to the deepest floor. 1K-Night is a pixel-art action hack-and-slash game set in a medieval European fantasy world. As a knight, you must source your weapons and food on-site as you strive to reach the bottom of the dungeon.

Unlike traditional RPGs, this is not turn-based; every action unfolds in real-time. Master a variety of weapons found along the way to strike down the monsters that stand in your path.

During your journey, you can recruit fellow knights to join your cause. While a larger party grants a significant tactical advantage, it comes with a catch: more mouths to feed means food supplies will dwindle much faster. Will you build a powerful army or venture cautiously with a small crew? Survival depends on how well you balance combat power with resource management.

Key Features:

  • Real-Time Action: Fast-paced hack-and-slash combat where your reflexes determine life or death.

  • Party Formation: Recruit other knights within the dungeon to fight by your side.

  • Hunger & Resource Management: Food consumption increases with your party size. Constant scavenging is vital for survival.

  • Random Drops: Discover different weapons, items, and food in every run, forcing you to adapt your strategy on the fly.

  • Medieval Pixel Art: A beautifully detailed fantasy world brought to life through intricate pixel art.
